_comment: Source of truth for api/tests/test_prompt_version_enforcement.py. Each entry pins BOTH halves of the text the model actually sees. `hash` is the SHA-256 (first 16 hex chars) of the hand-written prompt (forecaster.py's GATEKEEPER_PROMPT_HASH/EXTRACTOR_PROMPT_HASH). `schema_hash`/`schema_chars` cover the response model's JSON schema, which instructor's MD_JSON mode serialises into the prompt on every call — field descriptions, enum members and Pydantic docstrings included (retro#700); `schema_chars` is recorded separately from the hash so that growth shows up as a number in the diff, which is how the retro#681 regression should have been caught. Whenever an edit to either half changes model behavior materially: bump the matching *_PROMPT_VERSION constant in forecaster.py, add a row to docs/PROMPT_VERSIONS.md, and update this file to match. The test fails otherwise.
